Job Description Are you an experienced Field Service Engineer who enjoys traveling, solving technical challenges, and working on advanced industrial machinery? Do you want to be part of an international organization where no two projects are the same? Then this opportunity could be the perfect fit. As a Field Service Engineer, you will be responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance, and troubleshooting of high-end process equipment and complete production systems at customer sites around the world. You will act as the technical representative on-site, ensuring installations are delivered safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. Working closely with Engineering, Project Management, and Service teams, you will play a key role throughout the entire project lifecycle while building strong relationships with customers worldwide. Your responsibilities Install and commission industrial machinery and complete production lines at customer sites. Perform preventive maintenance, inspections, and repairs. Diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and control system faults. Test, optimize, and fine-tune equipment to ensure optimal performance. Train and support operators and maintenance teams. Prepare service reports and provide technical recommendations for improvements. Collaborate with Engineering and Project Management to successfully complete projects. Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with safety and quality standards. Arbeidsvoorwaarden You will join an internationally operating machine builder where innovation, technology, and personal development are at the heart of the business. We offer: A competitive salary based on your knowledge and experience. Attractive international travel and daily allowances. Annual bonus scheme. 27 vacation days plus 13 additional ADV (reduction of working hours) days. Excellent pension scheme. Company laptop, mobile phone, and professional tools. Extensive training and careerdevelopment opportunities. The opportunity to work on challenging international projects. A high level of independence and responsibility. Functie-eisen We are looking for a hands-on engineer with a passion for technology and international travel. You have: An MBO Level 4 or Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience as a Field Service Engineer, Commissioning Engineer, or Service Technician within machine building or industrial automation. Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and preferably PLC-controlled systems. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Good communication skills in English (Dutch is an advantage). A willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis. A valid driver's license (Category B). A customer-focused and independent working attitude. Hier kom je te werken Our client is a globally recognized machine builder specializing in the design, production, and maintenance of advanced process equipment and complete production facilities for the feed and food processing industry. From its modern headquarters in the Netherlands, the company designs, manufactures, assembles, and services complete turnkey installations for customers across the globe. Innovation, quality, and continuous improvement are deeply embedded in the company culture, creating an environment where employees are encouraged to develop both professionally and personally.

Are you an experienced Quality Manager ready to lead change in a high-tech manufacturing environment? Xelvin is looking for a Quality Manager to join an internationally operating technology company in the Eindhoven region. In this strategic leadership role, you will drive quality excellence, lead a multidisciplinary team of engineers, and play a key role in supporting the company's growth ambitions within the semiconductor industry. If you thrive in complex technical environments, enjoy leading people through transformation, and are passionate about continuous improvement, this could be your next career move. About the role Our client is a leading supplier of highly engineered precision components used in advanced technological applications. Operating within the global semiconductor supply chain, the company develops and manufactures critical products that contribute to some of the world's most innovative technologies. As Quality Manager, you will be responsible for leading a team of approximately ten quality professionals, ranging from experienced specialists to ambitious junior engineers. You will ensure product and process quality standards are maintained while driving organizational improvements, fostering collaboration, and strengthening a culture of operational excellence. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A challenging leadership role within a rapidly growing high-tech organization. Competitive salary based on experience and expertise. Performance-based bonus scheme. 27 vacation days plus 13 additional ADV days. Excellent pension and secondary benefits package. Opportunities for professional growth, training, and career development. An international work environment with colleagues from over 25 nationalities. A culture focused on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Regular company events, sports activities, and social gatherings. Functie-eisen To succeed in this position, you bring: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or another relevanttechnical discipline. Proven leadership experience within quality management in a high-tech manufacturing environment. Experience within the semiconductor industry or a similarly demanding technical sector. Strong knowledge of quality methodologies and continuous improvement tools such as Six Sigma, DMAIC, PDCA, SPC, 8D, APQP, and PPAP. Experience with quality management systems and QESH standards. Demonstrated experience in change management and organizational development. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities. Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Hier kom je te werken Our client is an internationally recognized technology manufacturer specializing in high-precision engineered components for demanding industrial applications. Their products play a critical role in advanced manufacturing environments where reliability, accuracy, and consistency are essential. Driven by innovation and continuous improvement, the company serves leading customers worldwide and operates within one of the fastest-growing sectors of the global technology market. Employees benefit from a collaborative, multicultural environment where technical expertise, personal development, and teamwork are highly valued.

jobs.occupation: Talent Pool for Campus Internships 2027 – Finance (location: Terneuzen, Netherlands)
jobs.description:
About this talent pool
Looking for an internship starting between January and October 2027, but not seeing any open positions on our website? We then encourage you to sign up for this Dow talent pool. 
Important - This is NOT an individual job opening. If your profile matches a future internship position, our recruiting team will contact you directly.
 

About youWe are looking for 
bachelor’s and
 master’s students (m/f) to support our Finance organization in Terneuzen, the Netherlands.
 

Our Finance organization provides services for several European countries providing you with an international work experience. The department consists of several sub-departments such as Cost Accounting, Treasury, Financial & Statutory, Tax, Credit, Invoice to Cash, and Internal Audit. You will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience and work on projects that align with your interests and career goals.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Work on process improvement initiatives. 

• Preparation and review of financial statements. 

• Data analyzing and financial reporting. 

• Review of the VAT and/or Intrastat returns. 

• Implement automation solutions into current processes. 

• Preparing Balance sheet account reconciliations. 

• Connect with other Dow departments like Logistics, Procure to Pay, Customs and HR. 

• Explore tools like SAP, Office (co-pilot), SharePoint, Power Automate. 

Qualifications
 
 

• You are currently studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in (corporate) finance, accounting, economics, business administration, international business or related field. 

• You have a good working knowledge of English. 

• You are looking to do an internship for 5 to 6 months starting between January and October 2027 (exact timing to be discussed). 

• You can legally work in the Netherlands due to EU-citizenship or already obtained student visa for the Netherlands.
